We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr VMware Horizon Engineer (SME) to join our team. As the SME, you will provide technical expertise, troubleshoot complex issues, and ensure the stability, scalability, and performance of the VMware Horizon platform. Design and Implementation:

Technical Expertise:
• Serve as the subject matter expert for VMware Horizon and related technologies.

Support and Troubleshooting:
• Provide Level 2/3 support for complex issues related to VMware Horizon and VDI environments.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and ensure user satisfaction.

Documentation and Training:
• Create and maintain detailed documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and standard operating procedures.

Security and Compliance:
• Ensure the VMware Horizon environment adheres to organizational security policies and compliance requirements.
• Implement security best practices for VDI, including multi-factor authentication and data encryption.
• Performance Optimization:
• Analyze and optimize the performance of the VMware Horizon environment to ensure a seamless user experience.
• Conduct capacity planning and scalability assessments to support future growth.

Qualifications Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
• 5+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience with VMware Horizon.
• Expertise in VMware Horizon components, including Connection Servers, Unified Access Gateways, App Volumes, and Dynamic Environment Manager.
• Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies, including VMware vSphere and ESXi.
• Proficiency in Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy management.
• Experience with networking concepts, including VLANs, firewalls, and load balancers.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Preferred:
• VMware Certified Professional (VCP) certification in Desktop and Mobility or Data Center Virtualization.
• Experience with cloud-based VDI solutions, such as VMware Horizon Cloud on Azure or AWS.
• Familiarity with scripting and automation tools (e.g., PowerShell, Python).
• Knowledge of ITIL processes and frameworks.

Key Competencies:
• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.
• Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
